verificationSummary: Editor merge commit d9cc21fe2472bd1a611eb6f971b102f69d5dbc3e adds bounded columns authoring readiness. RED evidence included npm run test -- src/tests/columnsAuthoringReadiness.test.ts failing because columnsAuthoringReadiness did not exist; npm run test -- src/tests/addNodeVisibleActions.test.ts failing because Text actions still targeted the Columns surface and selected summary-left-text still exposed columns.insert; and npm run test -- src/tests/nodePresentation.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts failing because represented column ids were absent. GREEN evidence passed npm run test -- src/tests/columnsAuthoringReadiness.test.ts with 5 tests; npm run test -- src/tests/addNodeVisibleActions.test.ts with 4 tests; npm run test -- src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts with 8 tests; npm run test -- src/tests/nodePresentation.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts with 12 tests; focused npm run test -- src/tests/columnsAuthoringReadiness.test.ts src/tests/addNodeVisibleActions.test.ts src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts src/tests/nodePlacementReadiness.test.ts src/tests/addNodeContract.test.ts src/tests/addNodeActivationHarness.test.ts src/tests/nodePresentation.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts with 8 files and 37 tests; npm run type-check; npm run check in the Editor worktree with 104 test files, 376 tests, and build; and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke. Merged Editor main passed the same focused 8-file/37-test gate, npm run check with 104 test files, 376 tests, and build, followed by the same no-write live Backend smoke with final Outline order editor-text-block-zone-cover-body-1 > title > editor-columns-zone-cover-body-2 > summary-columns > summary-left-text > summary-right-text > detail-table > detail-cell-a-text > detail-cell-b-text. The implemented behavior resolves selected summary-columns to text append under summary-left, selected summary-right to text append under summary-right, selected summary-left-text to same-column sibling placement under summary-left, and blocks cross-column sibling placement into summary-right. Structure exposes data-outline-add-container and Paper projection exposes data-canvas-column-id/data-canvas-columns-id. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, Table editing, exact table cell editing UI, exact column layout editing UI, a user-facing column picker, nested Columns insertion proof inside columns, Core or Backend document v4 insert semantics, arbitrary rich-inline authoring beyond the existing bounded textarea path, field-ref chip editing, durable drafts, collaboration, cross-browser readiness, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, full large-document authoring performance readiness, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Editor npm install still reports 5 high severity audit findings and Vite retains the existing chunk-size warning. The Editor branch fd-ed-columns-boundary-0831 was deleted after merge; Git no longer lists C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/flowdoc-vnext-editor/.worktrees/fd-ed-columns-boundary-0831 as a worktree, but that residual folder remains on disk after git worktree remove failed with Directory not empty and direct recursive deletion was intentionally avoided because dependency links have previously caused cleanup risk.
